title: Jo Jones and other visiting drummers
summary: Moore rarely talked with Jo Jones; visiting drummers were wary of his wild multi-instrument solos.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: How about Jo Jones? Did you get a chance to talk shop with him?

Well, no, he... I didn't have a chance to talk to Jo Jones very much. He'd always go downtown and sit in them different places, you know... He'd step into the Victoria there once in a while with (?). Of course, his style of playing and mine is different, you know.

But they had a lot of different drummers used to stop in there. Cozy Cole I think was... There was quite a few of them who stopped in. Some of them would play, some of them wouldn't. So all them good drummers who'd come in there, I'd put everything on them that I know what to do on drums. And he kind of got a little leery of me a little bit.
